papers.title: Large Language Models: A Survey
papers.summary: A broad overview of how modern LLMs (GPT, LLaMA, PaLM families) work, covering their architectures, training techniques, datasets, and evaluation methods.

papers.title: A Survey of Large Language Models
papers.summary: One of the most widely cited LLM surveys, tracing the evolution from statistical to neural language models and explaining pre-training, adaptation, usage, and evaluation of LLMs.

papers.title: Foundations of Large Language Models
papers.summary: A textbook-style introduction covering the core building blocks of LLMs: pre-training, generative modeling, prompting, alignment, inference, and reasoning.
